label: .NET mutation testing (Stryker.NET)
description: Mutation testing of .NET solutions with the tools image's Stryker.NET, in a copy of the component inside the run folder. Comes in by evidence: a stryker-config file or dotnet-stryker in the local tool manifest; runs only where mutation is switched on (the strict profile turns it on when available). Bounded to 15 minutes (timeoutSeconds 900): a run that exceeds it has no score.
